title: Inspect the evidence
detail: Paste or import a revealed round payload. The reusable verifier checks the commitment, game outcome, action history and payout entirely in this browser, using the six approved math profiles. No payload or device record is sent to a service.
recordHelp: A stored or imported record is supplied evidence. Its source, device authenticity and pre-bet creation time are not established by importing it. This verifier only reads records; actual player record creation is separate.
storageHelp: A separate verifier origin cannot read the player origin’s storage. Same-origin lookup uses only this verifier origin and browser profile; missing or unreadable records lower the evidence level.
rawHelp: Your original JSON text is kept here. Comparisons use one parsed object with exact numeric values. Duplicate member names select the last value; this does not verify raw transport canonicality.
ready: Ready to verify. Changing any input clears the previous result.
changed: Inputs changed. Run verification for the current inputs.
verifying: Verifying the current payload and record…
payloadReadError: INPUT_ERROR: The payload file could not be read. Paste JSON or choose another file.
recordReadError: The device record file could not be read. It will be treated as unreadable when verification runs.
inputError: INPUT_ERROR: The payload is not valid JSON. Correct it and run verification again.
cryptoError: CRYPTO_UNAVAILABLE: Web Crypto is unavailable in this browser context. No verification result is available.
operationError: VERIFICATION_ERROR: Verification could not finish. No success has been established.
limits: This check does not, by itself, prove when the operator’s systems computed the result, or that no other bet was rejected. Those are covered by audited operating controls. Comparisons with a device record assume that the game client and the record it stored were not tampered with. Import does not authenticate that source.
payoutLimits: Payout verification does not prove wallet settlement, correct casino limits configuration, stake-lattice membership, stake availability, maximum stake or the configured settlement precision. It reproduces the amount shown from the supplied wager, outcome and approved math profile.
completeStorage: Verified against this origin’s stored record.
completeDetail: The revealed server seed matches the commitment in the supplied submission. Client inputs, wager and every player action match the supplied record. Together they reproduce exactly the result and payout shown. If the record faithfully represents an untampered pre-bet receipt, this comparison shows the seed could not have been chosen after seeing that recorded randomness.
partialSupplied: Partly verified against the supplied record.
partialStorage: Partly verified against this origin’s stored record.
partialDetail: The result and payout are reproduced exactly from the values shown. Only the submission and actions listed as checked match the supplied record. Unwitnessed actions are shown as reported by the operator; they were not made or not seen in this supplied record.
noneTitle: Consistent, but not checked against your device.
noneDetail: The revealed server seed matches the commitment in this payload. With the client seed and client randomness in this payload, it reproduces exactly the result and payout shown. This does not show that you saw this commitment before betting, or that the client seed, wager and actions shown are yours.
absent: No record was supplied or found for this round.
unreadable: The supplied device record for this round could not be read. It was treated as absent evidence.
emptyRecord: The supplied record was readable but contained no submission or actions to compare.
checked: checked — commitment, client seed, client randomness and wager
unchecked: not checked — no readable submission was supplied
noSuccess: No successful full verification is established by this result.

resultDetails.NOT_REVEALED: Not verifiable yet: the server seed has not been revealed.
resultDetails.RECOVERED_NOT_VERIFIABLE: Recovered round — fairness evidence unavailable. This round is not verifiable.
resultDetails.UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: A protocol, game or math-profile version is unsupported.
resultDetails.COMMITMENT_MISMATCH: The revealed seed does not match the supplied commitment.
resultDetails.CLIENT_RECORD_MISMATCH: The supplied record contradicts this payload.
resultDetails.OUTCOME_MISMATCH: The reproduced outcome does not match the claimed outcome.
resultDetails.INVALID_TILE: The Mines action history contains an invalid or repeated tile.
resultDetails.ACTION_AFTER_TERMINAL: The Mines action history continues after the round ended.
resultDetails.MISSING_TERMINAL: The Mines action history has no valid ending.
resultDetails.CASHOUT_WITHOUT_SAFE_TILE: The Mines history cashes out before any safe tile.
resultDetails.PAYOUT_MISMATCH: The reproduced payout does not match the supplied economics.

identityUnavailable: Source provenance unavailable. No exact source identity is established for this build.
identityCaveat: Build-time metadata only. No tag or deployed identity is established.
